name: Disappointment
overview: Disappointment often arises when our own plans and understanding fail to align with God's perfect will, but Scripture reassures believers that the LORD directs our steps beyond our limited insight. In times of brokenness and contrite spirit, God draws near to comfort and save, inviting us to trust Him fully rather than lean on our own understanding. By fearing the LORD and embracing His peace, we can overcome envy and discouragement, resting in His promise of a hopeful future and clear vision for our lives.
